usageNotes: Retrieves the MAC-VRF (MAC Virtual Routing and Forwarding) table entry for a specific EVPN-backed VNet as seen by a given node on a remote PVE cluster. Use this to inspect the EVPN control-plane state — specifically which IP and nexthop are associated with a learned MAC address — when troubleshooting L2/L3 EVPN reachability across fabric nodes. The VNet must be backed by an EVPN zone; calling this against a plain VXLAN or VLAN zone will yield no meaningful result.

examples.summary: Fetch the MAC-VRF entry for VNet 'vnet10' on node 'pve01' of remote cluster 'dc-west'

tips: The returned 'mac' field uses a locally-administered address pattern (second nibble in [02468ace]); this is normal for EVPN-generated MAC entries.
The 'nexthop' IP is the VTEP address of the remote node advertising the route — cross-reference it against node tunnel IPs to identify which physical host owns the endpoint.
If the response returns an empty or missing 'ip' field, the MAC was learned at L2 only (no ARP/ND snooping entry yet).
Use 'localhost' as the node value when targeting the PDM host's local PVE node without knowing its hostname.
